initial.source: Unmodified bfed4a3, npm ci then npm run build; tests added before runtime changes.

extended.source: Fresh transpilation of original IO sources from bfed4a3 into dist, restored from in-memory buffers in finally.

redEvidence.note: The Report/2 adapter case is additional integration coverage, not claimed as a discriminating baseline probe for that new API.

tests: J4 #13 should accept an empty injected extension map across F1 boundaries
J4 #13 should derive collection multiplicity from descriptors
findings.red: Empty injected map refused invalid-configuration; two entries in an isMany Element slot refused duplicate-extension.
findings.fix: Remove forced descriptor equality and named singleton policy. Hydrate/project use caller descriptors; parsing shares its validated factory with the observer and native reader.
findings.green: Both tests pass: exact minimal Definitions probe, empty-map parse/project and repeated collection entries.

tests: J4 #14 should refuse effective descriptor uri drift
J4 #14 should refuse effective descriptor inheritance drift
J4 #14 should refuse effective descriptor xml drift
findings.red: All three configurations projected without a refusal (Missing expected exception).
findings.fix: Compare complete effective descriptors and non-enumerable package identity, including inherited packages, URI and XML metadata. Cache is per conversion.
findings.green: Each drift refuses descriptor-mismatch; the original configuration still projects afterward.

tests: J4 #21 should preserve attribute pointer segment a.b
J4 #21 should preserve attribute pointer segment a~b
J4 #21 should preserve attribute pointer segment a/b
J4 #21 should preserve attribute pointer segment a[0]
J4 #21 should retain ancestor targets for primitive failures
J4 #21 should locate F7 geometry failures with an ancestor target
J4 #21 should preserve ancestor targets on native warnings
J4 #21 should satisfy sealed coordinates for <caseId> (all 12 reserved/entity/numeric vectors)
findings.red: a.b became a/b, a~b lacked ~0, a/b lacked ~1 and a[0] became a/0. Primitive errors had no target; F7 had no diagnostic path. All 12 sealed XML coordinates were empty.
findings.fix: Quote opaque display-path segments and encode RFC 6901 pointers from parsed segments. Keep ancestor IDs through primitive, warning, F7 and deferred reference validation. Observe source coordinates through the pinned tokenizer before native construction.
findings.green: Nineteen tests pass; all 12 independently sealed coordinates compare exactly. ID-less bounds error points to width and targets Shape.

tests: J4 #22 should refuse misplaced reserved typed fields with reserved-name
J4 #22 should refuse own generic get in project and F7
J4 #22 should refuse own generic set in project and F7
J4 #22 should enforce every independently sealed reserved name
findings.red: Misplaced $parent used unknown-property; generic get/set were accepted silently. Final union probe failed with Missing expected exception: __contains__ before adding four omitted sealed members.
findings.fix: Apply the closed union to unknown typed fields and generic foreign properties. Recognize only non-enumerable callable runtime methods; overwritten methods refuse. Apply reserved-name per reviewer D1 arbitration. Add hasType, __contains__, __getitem__ and __setitem__ from the existing sealed enumeration.
findings.green: All four tests pass, including every sealed reserved name through hydrate, project and F7.

tests: J4 #23 should expose mixed content loss at the XML boundary
J4 #23 should expose native integer coercion without changing the value
J4 #23 should refuse an unbound foreign writer attribute before writing
J4 #23 should preserve upstream prefix-loss bytes and expose a diagnostic
J4 #23 should adapt normalization to Report/2 with exact presence and source
findings.red: Mixed text, 1.5-to-1 coercion and prefix stripping yielded empty diagnostics; unbound foreign attribute writing resolved successfully.
findings.fix: Observe mixed content and primitive coercion at XML events. Refuse unbound writer attributes. Add serializeBpmnWithDiagnostics with unchanged native bytes and typed prefix-loss diagnostics; add a Report/2 adapter requiring caller-supplied presence/values and coordinate-domain selection.
findings.green: Four discriminating probes and the additional Report/2 integration case pass; writer bytes equal the upstream oracle.
